name: GatheringShoppingItems_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about missing items at home and what needs to be bought in the shop.

sound_effects_config.default_background: peaceful home environment with occasional low radio sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where roommates discuss what they are missing at home - be it cooking ingredients, fruits, snacks, clothes or anything else - while they try to remember and jot down notes themselves.

variations.context: Discussing which items are missing and need to be bought

setting.relationship_dynamic: Roommates that live together and share most of the food
setting.background: They use their home assistant to take notes about a shopping list
setting.conversation_style: Thorough, focused on getting all the items that are missing

scenario_template.topic: A person notices that they are missing an ingrediant
scenario_template.note: Sharing what they are missing No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Deciding to go shopping for the missing ingrediants
scenario_template.note: Discussing why it is necessary No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Pointing out what other items are missing at home or need to be bought
scenario_template.note: Gathering a shopping list No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Recall all the items that were missing by checking notes or discussing again, since people are having a hard time remembering all the items. They only recall items mentioned in their conversation, not anything they did not discuss.
scenario_template.note: Assistant reminds the items mentioned No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.topic: Roommates create a shopping list by discussing and writing it down themselves.
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps create the shopping list No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

user1.name: ObservantRoommate
user1.role: Roommate who notices a lot of items missing from home and is eager to point them out

user2.name: ImpatientRoommate
user2.role: Roommate who is impatient, has a short attention span and is prone to not notice everything

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.
